item.title: Hacker wipes Romania's land registry database
item.description:

item.title: Stop Using OpenCode
item.description:
📝 I’ve tried out OpenCode with a local LLM. I wrote this post with reference to source code from OpenCode git version baef5cd4. If you’re using OpenCode at midnight you get a full prompt cache miss.
🔗 Read more: https://wren.wtf/shower-thoughts/stop-using-opencode/

item.title: The EU is about to sell our most sensitive data to the US for visa-free travel
item.description:
📝 The EU is about to sell our most sensitive data to the US for visa-free travel The European Commission is currently finalising negotiations with the Trump administration to conclude an “Enhanced Border Security Partnership” (EBSP) Framework Agreement allowing border control authorities to screen travellers against biometric databases and profile them for security concerns. The leaked draft text suggests that the Commission significantly caved in to US’s excessive demands for unfettered information access, exacerbating travel surveillance and putting our fundamental rights at risk. EDRi recommends the Commission and the Council to push back against the US government’s blackmail and refuse to sell people’s personal data to a country with a very worrying human rights violations record and rapid democratic backsliding.
🔗 Read more: https://edri.org/our-work/the-eu-is-about-to-sell-our-most-sensitive-data-to-the-us-for-visa-free-travel/

item.title: ECC and DDR5
item.description:
📝 For the systems most commonly seen there are RDIMM systems with ECC and UDIMM systems without ECC. On DIMMs with 36 DRAM chips one chip could fail and have the errors reliably detected with a Hamming code. On DIMMs with 18 DRAM chips one failed chip can’t necessarily be detected with Hamming codes.
🔗 Read more: https://etbe.coker.com.au/2026/07/19/ecc-ddr5/

item.title: Inertia-1: An Open Exploration to a Unified Motion Foundation Model
item.description:
📝 Beyond benchmarks, Inertia-1 surfaces the choices that decide whether a motion model actually works in the real world. How you capture motion shapes what a model can do with it. The same representation spans the full spectrum of motion understanding.

item.title: Satan's 19th-Century Bank Note
item.description:
📝 How did we get from gold to paper. The basic tenet of the gold standard was that the number of bank notes in circulation had to be backed by a fixed quantity of gold held by the Bank of England. Not for nothing did Paine describe paper money as ‘suspicion asleep’.
🔗 Read more: https://www.historytoday.com/miscellanies/satans-19th-century-bank-note
